name: an inline foreach keeps the order of the array when it has more than ten items
loop metadata counts through more than ten items
template:
$/ foreach i in list
$i.index()$/$i.count()$$/ if i.last() !$/ endif
$/ endfor

name: order by sorts numbers as numbers, not as text
template:
$/ foreach i in list order by i.n
$i.n$
$/ endfor

name: order by desc reverses the numeric order
template:
$/ foreach i in list order by i.n desc
$i.n$
$/ endfor
